name: NK Woodworking & Design
old_description: Founded in 2011, NK Woodworking & Design is one of the most respected architectural millwork & design firms in the world.
about:
NK Woodworking & Design was founded in 2011 in Seattle, Washington, by a group of skilled craftsmen, engineers, and designers who shared a passion for art and woodworking. The company began as a collaborative workshop focused on creating architectural millwork and custom art pieces for residential projects.

Today the firm operates a 12,000-square-foot woodshop in Seattle and maintains a satellite location in Los Angeles, supported by a network of artisan spaces. Its integrated process covers design, engineering, fabrication, and installation, producing custom wood, metal, and glass millwork such as curved staircases, doors, sculptural features, and built-in shelving. The fabrication team handles all production in-house and travels to project sites nationwide to lead installation.

NK Woodworking serves homeowners, interior designers, architects, and custom home builders across the United States. Its work appears in high-end residential interiors where architectural millwork is a focal point, and the company collaborates closely with design professionals from concept through final installation.

The company states that art and woodworking are its driving passion, and it emphasizes a commitment to the highest quality standards by fabricating pieces in as large sections as possible to ensure precision during on-site assembly.
